title: Importing the Standard Library
learning_objectives: Import modules with import, from ... import and as
Use math, random, collections, heapq and itertools for common tasks
Make random results reproducible with random.Random(seed)
Explain what each library function replaces
entry_point: hypotenuse(a, b); pages_needed(items, per_page); most_common_letter(text); dice_rolls(seed, n); smallest_k(nums, k); all_pairs(items)
hints: `math.ceil(items / per_page)` rounds up; `Counter(ch for ch in text.lower() if ch.isalpha())` counts letters.
For ties, find the highest count, then return `min` of the letters that have it.

failure_feedback.advice: Lowercase first, keep only `ch.isalpha()`, break ties with `min`, and return None when nothing is left.
Create `random.Random(seed)` inside the function and use only `rng.random()`.
Convert the combinations iterator to a list of tuples.
